notes.title: Patch notes - Wigged Out August Update
notes.notes: [p]Two brand new levels are added to Wigged Out, Bypass Buffer and Dingy Divide![/p][h3][b]Dingy Divide[/b][/h3][p]This Campus area level is divided down the middle by two hedges with a walkway in between. You can only get the ball through by moving it along the sides or sending it airborne over the hedges. But be aware of the goat, it will chase you if you get too close![/p][h3][b]Bypass Buffer[/b][/h3][p]Use the flippers located at each goal to give the big ball an extra momentum and try to avoid hitting the bumpers, as they will knock the big ball all over the place! But if you’re a big fan of randomness and chaos, this level also comes in a second variation, with even more bumpers![/p]

notes.notes: [p]A brand new content update for Wigged Out is now available, and this time we’re adding two new levels, a new wig and a new hat![/p][h1]New Levels[/h1][p]In the spirit of the summer season we’re adding two new Golf themed Country Side levels this time[/p][p][b]Country Clubbing[/b][/p][p]This level takes place at a fancy high-end country club, and comes in three different variations, each with their own hazard configurations[/p][p][b]Rock n Roll[/b][/p][p]Located deep in the forest, surrounded by mountains and rivers, this golf themed level requires precision and timing to get the ball past the moving fences and into the goal. And for some added chaos, you can release the big rolling stones by pulling the levers![/p][h1]New Unlockables[/h1][p]Two new unlockables are also added, each with their own unlock challenges[/p][p][b]Top Braid[/b](Wig) - Give your head that extra breathing room during hot summer days by tying up all that hair into one long, stylish braid[/p][p][b]Cap[/b](Hat) - Protect your eyes from the sun with this practical cap, a must-have for those sunny days out on the course![/p]

notes.title: Patch notes - With updated content!
notes.notes:
[b]We’ve just dropped a fresh update packed with 4 brand-new levels and 3 stylish new unlockables, each with their own unique unlock challenge! Check out what’s new below[/b]

[h2][b]New levels:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[b]Basic Bumps[/b]
If you want more unpredictability, this is the level for you. With big bumps, or shall we say small hills, all over the map, you have to stay focused at all times to predict where the big ball is going! 

[b]Halfway House[/b]
In this level you have to navigate around a park area with a big fountain in it. But, if you look closely, you might notice a shortcut to reach the other side quickly! 

[b]Hostile Half[/b]
Speaking of shortcuts, on this large level, using the shortcuts might be the difference between winning and losing! The same goes for using the flippers at the right moment! 

[b]Bombastic Banana[/b]
A level shaped like a banana. That's it. That’s the description. Go play it.[/list]

[b]Last Straw[/b] (wig) – It's straw. Sort of. Just try it.

notes.title: Wigged Out Major Update
notes.notes:
[b]Big changes are added to Wigged Out![/b]
We’ve been hard at work tweaking, refining, and adding in new content to make the game even more chaotic and fun. This update brings new features, crucial fixes, and a whole lot of polish!
Some of the newest additions include two brand-new items—the [b]Toilet[/b] and the [b]Big Fish[/b]—ready to shake up the game! And for those who prefer to let their actions do the talking, we’ve added an [b]emote system[/b], so you can express yourself without saying a word.
We’ve also dedicated a lot of effort into improving online play[/b], making matches smoother and more reliable than ever.
Thank you for your continued support—your feedback keeps us going! Now, let’s dive into the patch notes:

[h1][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h1]

[h3][b]Major Updates[/b][/h3]
[b]Performance & Networking[/b]
[list][*]Optimized the entire game, improving networking stability and reducing lag.
[*]Camera optimizations across all scenes (no more multiple cameras active at once).
[*][b]Goals are now properly synced for all clients.[/b][/list]
[b]New Features & Content[/b]
[list][*][b]In-Game Emoji Feature:[/b] Added an emoji wheel for quick in-game expressions.
[*][b]New Item – Toilet:[/b] Added a new in-game item with unique mechanics.
[*][b]New Item – Fish:[/b] Added a new in-game item with unique mechanics.
[*][b]New Item – Banana cluster:[/b] Added a new in-game item with unique mechanics.
[*]Added [b]rotation [/b]to character in collection menu

[/list]
[b]Localization & UI Overhaul[/b]
[list][*]Full [b]localization update[/b], including better handling of language changes.
[*]Fixed [b]misaligned UI elements[/b], such as "Local" and "Online" text overlaps.
[*]Improved [b]announcement texts[/b] and UI readability.
[*]Fixed [b]room code display issue[/b] when switching languages.[/list]
[b]Critical Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Fixed [b]softlock issues[/b] that could occur when pausing or entering menus.
[*]Fixed [b]players getting stuck[/b] in different situations.
[*]Fixed [b]unresponsive inputs[/b] when disconnecting/reconnecting controllers.
[*]Improved [b]matchmaking handling[/b], reducing the chance of getting stuck in online rooms.[/list]

[h3][b]Minor Updates[/b][/h3]
[b]Gameplay & Mechanics[/color][/b]
[list][*][b]Collision & Interaction Adjustments
[/b]
[list][*][b]Increased trigger rate[/b] for items like the lance.
[*][b]New collision shape added[/b] for the lance.
[*][b]Better collision checks[/b] for Jock ult.
[*][b]Fans no longer push players[/b] who have the “NoKnock” effect active.
[*][b]Clients can now predict interactions[/b] with placed items/hazards, reducing lag in physics-based interactions.
[*][b]Spawning & Character Behavior
[/b]
[*][b]Fixed player spawning issues:[/b] Only player one spawns when returning to the main menu.
[*][b]Lucy’s Dog now correctly spawns on the ground[/b] instead of falling through.
[*][b]Fixed rotation of George[/b] in collection.
[*][b]Fixed an issue where characters were hiding when changing levels.[/b]
[*][b]Balance Adjustments
[/b]
[*][b]Increased collision check rate[/b] for Brad’s ultimate ability.
[*][b]Adjusted item and ability balancing.[/b]
[*][b]Rotating goal is now easier to score on from both sides.[/b][/list]
[b]Visual & UI Enhancements[/b]
[list][*][b]Collection & Trophy Scene Improvements
[/b]
[list][*][b]Added new collection arrows[/b] for better UI navigation.
[*][b]Characters now rotate properly[/b] in the collection menu.
[*][b]Smoother, less laggy trophy scene.[/b]
[*][b]Less “deep-fried” trophy images & improved camera angles.[/b]
[*][b]General UI Fixes
[/b]
[*][b]Removed button focus[/b] from “Create” game button; now defaults to "Join".
[*][b]Fixed UI alignment[/b] on multiple screens.
[*][b]Menu animations improved.[/b]
[*][b]Fixed spacing in text & announcement popups.[/b]
[*][b]Added auto-changing glyphs[/b] on the intro screen based on platform.
[*][b]Other Visual Fixes
[/b]
[*][b]New particle effects for fountains.[/b]
[*][b]Updated aim decals[/b] for Banans, Wig Keg, and the Toilet item.
[*][b]Fixed clipping issues with characters in collection mode.[/b]
[*][b]Fixed camera optimization in all scenes.[/b]
[*][b]Removed camera shake from Big Ball when affected by “Taps.”[/b][/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*][b]Controller & Input Fixes
[/b]
[list][*][b]Fixed controller disconnect issues[/b] in online matches.
[*][b]Fixed unresponsive controls when disconnecting controller at specific times.[/b]
[*][b]Game now properly pauses when opening Steam overlay.[/b]
[*][b]Online & Matchmaking Fixes
[/b]
[*][b]Fixed room code updating when changing language.[/b]
[*][b]Players no longer get stuck if they fail to join a room.[/b]
[*][b]Clients now see a 'Waiting for Host' notification[/b] when the host is deciding on match settings.
[*][b]Teams are no longer considered balanced if all players are on one team.[/b]
[*][b]Animation Fixes
[/b]
[*][b]Fixed animation pop issues[/b] when changing wigs with Jock.
[*][b]Fixed animation issues in tutorial (Coach animations).[/b]
[*][b]Fixed wig-related animation bugs.[/b]
[*][b]Miscellaneous
[/b]
[*][b]Fixed issue where achievements weren’t saving/loading properly.[/b]
[*][b]Fixed floating props in some levels.[/b]
[*][b]Removed redundant logs that were spamming the console.[/b][/list]

notes.title: WIGGED OUT - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b]-Tutorial:[/b]

The camera now persistently focuses on Brad when using the Wigout Power.

Users cannot pause during the WigOut initiation.

[b]-Gameplay:[/b]

The ranged wig no longer becomes unusable when bouncing off certain objects.

Players can throw the wig, hitting reported items without losing it afterwards.

[b]-Softlock Fix:[/b]

Players can now return to the Main Menu Room after joining an online match, then a local match.

[b]-[/b][b]Pause Menu Optimization:[/b]

The Wigout Power no longer loads quickly when the pause menu is opened, preventing the WiggedOut Meter from increasing.

[b]-Animations:[/b]

Fixed an issue where entering the Pause Menu during Charles/Lucy/Brad's Wigout Power animation caused a modification in skill. Users can no longer pause during the WigOut state.

[b]-Locker Room Control:[/b]

Second players in online matches can now control their WigOut Power display in the Locker Room.

notes.title: WIGGED OUT - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
-Lobby:
Improved Visibility:
"Add Bot" and "Remove Bot" text relocated inside empty portrait frames for better visibility.
Online Room Code Menu Fix:
Each option now has its own button prompt for clarity: "A" to Accept and "B" to Go Back.


-In-Game:
Melee Wigs Persistence:
Resolved issue where Melee Wigs would disappear after first use as a client.

Teleporter Item Fix:
Teleporter item can now be removed from one player to another as expected.

Fan Mechanics Adjustment:
Fans only exert force when there is air present, preventing constant pushing.

Hazards Behavior Fix:
Fire Hydrant and Manhole hazards now correctly push and stun characters upon contact.


-Purple Passing Level (Country Side):
Bridge Accessibility:
Characters can now walk across the bridge in Purple Passing level instead of being obstructed.


-Tutorials:
Text Correction:
All tutorial texts have been reviewed and corrected for accuracy.


-Settings:
Option Menu Improvement:
Audio and video settings no longer slide up slowly in the Game Options menu.


-Wigs:
Afro Wig Unlock Issue:
Afro wig unlocking issue has been resolved.


-General:
Mouse Cursor Lock:
Mouse cursor now stays locked within the game window during fullscreen mode to prevent accidental clicks outside the game.
